channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: IRGC says tanker caught fire after hitting mines in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: A liquefied gas carrier caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz after hitting naval mines, according to the IRGC.

item.title: At least 10 killed in Guinea clashes over gold mining ban
item.description: Guinea banned artisanal gold mining in Siguiri on November 2 due to environmental degradation, causing mass exodus.

item.title: Iran honours fallen soldiers in Iran-Iraq war with missile display
item.description: Thousands gathered in Tehran for a mass funeral honouring 110 unidentified soldiers killed in the Iran-Iraq war.

item.title: US Treasury warns against rate hikes during US-Iran war energy ‘shock’
item.description: Despite Treasury's Scott Bessent's remarks, financial tracker CME Fed Watch forecasts rate hike in December likely.

item.title: Truck and bus crash in India’s Assam state kills at least 24 people
item.description: Several children and the bus driver were among those killed, officials said, with the death toll expected to rise.

item.title: At least 24 killed after bus collides with truck in north-east India
item.description: Several of the deceased are college students, according to local official Atul Bora, but they have not yet been publicly identified.

item.title: Nigerian university in mourning after four students die at post-exam party
item.description: The university has banned all parties, while investigations are underway to find the cause of the students' deaths.
